name: What should I do to prepare my home for a plumbing maintenance visit?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home for a plumbing maintenance visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a plumbing maintenance visit, it's helpful to clear access to plumbing fixtures like under-sink areas, water heaters, and access panels. Make a note of any specific issues or concerns you've noticed, such as a dripping faucet or a slow drain. Being ready to discuss these points with the technician helps ensure all areas of concern are addressed during the inspection and service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear access to plumbing fixtures and note any specific issues you've observed to discuss with the technician.
